title: Australian Resort Trip Inquiry and Booking
transcript:
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Good afternoon. The Australia Travel Agency. How can I help you?
Speaker 0: Student: Good afternoon. I’d like to know some information about trips to different resorts.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Okay. Can you tell me some of your details first?
Speaker 2: Student: Of course. Travel Agent: What’s your occupation?
Speaker 0: Student: I’m a first year student.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Are you an Australian?
Speaker 0: Student: No. I’m from New York.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: So you are American?
Speaker 2: Student: Yes. Travel Agent: What’s your full name?
Speaker 0: Student: My name is Ariel Lee.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Tell me your contact number, please.
Speaker 0: Student: It is 46283095. And my address?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: No. We just need your contact number.
Speaker 0: Student: Okay. Can you introduce me some attractions?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Obviously, it varies, but always places of famous main resorts such as Sydney, Melbourne, or some places like that.
Speaker 0: Student: Just tour resorts? I mean, does that include other activities?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Yes. Besides main resorts, we will arrange for you to enjoy some local refreshments and some special activities.
Speaker 0: Student: So how much does it cost?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Usually, it varies between $20 and $35 per head, depending on the place.
Speaker 0: Student: And what is the departure date and time?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: It depends on various tours, but try to keep the departure time fixed. Student: When? Travel Agent: 07:00 in the morning.
Speaker 0: Student: And how about the transport?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: We have a minibus or coach depending on the number of tourists.
Speaker 0: Student: May I need a reservation?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Yes. You know, summer holidays are coming, so I suggest that tourists reserve a seat in advance.
Speaker 0: Student: Is there a discount for that?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: I’m sorry. We do not have any discounts during peak season.
Speaker 0: Student: Could you tell me some details of the trips?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Yes. The first place is Sydney. That’s on the January 12. We’ll have 25 people in a minibus.
Speaker 0: Student: Fine. Going to which attraction?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: We will visit one of the most famous theatres in the world.
Speaker 0: Student: The Sydney Opera House.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Right. You can appreciate and watch an opera there.
Speaker 0: Student: Really? What’s the name of the opera?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: I’m not sure. Let me check the house’s arrangements. And then you can visit the National Museum to know about the history and customs of Australia.
Speaker 0: Student: Great.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: In the evening, you can enjoy some local snacks if you like.
Speaker 0: Student: Fine.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: We’re going to the Blue Mountains on the January 25.
Speaker 0: Student: Blue Mountains. Is it a Blue Mountain?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: The mountain got its name for blue fog. It is usually covered by a blue fog.
Speaker 0: Student: That’s so interesting.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Yes. It is a popular place for young men because they are so cool, and you can enjoy lots of sports there such as rock climbing, bush walking, and bird watching.
Speaker 0: Student: How many people will go there together?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: You will take a coach that has about 30 seats.
Speaker 0: Fine.
Speaker 1: And the next place is Melbourne on the February 10 with about 20 people in a minibus.
Speaker 0: Student: What’s the resort?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: You could appreciate the famous Melbourne church, and maybe you might have a chance to attend a local exhibition if they hold it as usual.
Speaker 0: Student: Fine. Do you have some tours to the beach?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Yes. One of the most famous coral reefs in the world is the Great Barrier Reef, and we have arranged that on the February 23.
Speaker 0: Student: I’m looking forward to visiting there.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Yes. Many people like there. There are some interesting water sports such as diving, swimming in the water, or just taking a photo of coral.
Speaker 0: Student: Great. I guess there will be many people.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Yes. But our coach is only for 30 people altogether.
Speaker 0: Student: That’s so great. Can you book a seat for me now?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Yes. And I will confirm your reference number later by telephone. Okay?
Speaker 0: Student: Right. Thank you very much.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: You’re welcome. I hope you enjoy the trip.
